messages:
deploybot: DeployBot: rollout r-2026.04.09-58 (canary 12/50) automatically PAUSED at 12:03 UTC — incident INC-8423 (eu-west-1 kvcache spike). Gate: HOLD. Suggested actions: pin stable v3.14.2, abort remaining canaries, open rollback/hotpatch thread. https://incidents.local/INC-8423

maria.prodeng: Noted. @kevin-releaselead @tia-oncall — can we confirm scope? Are only eu instances affected?

tia-oncall: Confirmed. Impact limited to eu-west-1 canaries. Metrics: kv miss 28% -> 62% over last 3m. Dashboard: https://metrics.local/kvcache?range=15m

kevin-releaselead: Hold everything. Pin routing to v3.14.2 for prod traffic. Do NOT resume rollout until triage. No full rollback of prod until we know root cause. Notify EU customers if routing changes.

sam-sre: Agreed. If triage points to the runtime tweak from yesterday, plan is soft rollback of canaries then hotpatch. Proposed command: `deploybot rollback --canary r-2026.04.09-58 --to v3.14.2 --stagger 2m`

carol-eng: Triage started. I can reproduce increased backend load when seq_len > 1024 triggering extra cache evictions. Trying revert of `kv-cache-fallback` flag in canary group now. Will update in 15m.

olivia-pm: What should we tell customers? If we pin to 3.14.2 is user-facing impact minimal? Need an ETA for resume to include in release notes.

maria.prodeng: Status page update ready: "Degraded: EU canary traffic only. Rolling release paused while we investigate cache spike. Will provide updates every 30m." I'll post when we confirm pin.

deploybot: Action taken: pinned prod routing to version=3.14.2 globally; canaries remain paused. Ops log: `action=pin version=3.14.2 actor=deploybot ts=2951234567`. Notifying incident tracker.

incidents-bot: INC-8423 status changed -> investigation in progress, assignee=carol-eng, severity=P2. Next update ETA ~30m.

sam-sre: If rollback is accepted, we'll watch for errors and throttles. Plan B: build hotpatch with kv-cache-fix, smoke test in staging, then expedited canary (2 nodes) if green.

kevin-releaselead: Decision: HOLD rollout, PIN routing to 3.14.2, NO prod rollback for now. Proceed with triage+hotpatch. Reschedule remaining rollout to next change window: 2951270000 (approx +11h). @maria.prodeng please coordinate release notes and pipeline reschedule.

maria.prodeng: Will do. Drafting release note: "Paused due to eu canary cache spike; holding until hotpatch verification. Remainder tentatively rescheduled (see ops calendar)." Posting draft to #release-notes and calendar now.

carol-eng: Update: reverted `kv-cache-fallback` in canary; monitoring. Initial signal looks better (kv miss -> 34%). Will continue to watch for 10m before recommending next steps.

kevin-releaselead: Good. Keep the hold. If metrics stay improved, we'll run targeted smoke canary and then decide on staggered resume.

maria.prodeng: Noted. I'll keep stakeholders updated and send an incident-summary once we have root cause confirmed. :thumbsup:
